transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because... well, my sleep is just all broken up lately. I work overnight shifts as a personal care aide, and when I get off work, I just lie there wide awake. And then, when I finally do drift off, I wake up feeling scared, like... like I never even rested at all. It's just really getting to me.
Do you have bad dreams or nightmares when you finally fall asleep?

No, I don't really have nightmares. It's more just... waking up with this heavy, awful feeling. Like my heart is racing, but I can't remember dreaming about anything bad. I just open my eyes and feel terrified for no reason.
Do you think your overnight work shifts are contributing to your sleep problems?

I'm not really sure. I mean... I've been doing the overnight shifts for a good while now, and I used to be able to sleep fine when I got home. So... I don't know if the schedule is what's causing it now. It just feels different lately, I guess.
Do you feel anxious or on edge at other times of the day, not just when you wake up?

Um... no, I don't think so. Not really anxious, anyway. That panicked feeling is mostly just right when I wake up. The rest of the time... I just feel really heavy and drained, I guess. But I wouldn't say I'm walking around feeling on edge during the day.
Has something particularly stressful happened to you recently?

No, not really. I mean, nothing stands out. Work is work, you know? It's always a little stressful, but it hasn't been any worse than usual. Life's just been the same routine. There hasn't been any big event or emergency or anything like that. Just... everything feels harder now, even though nothing actually changed.
Did these sleep problems and waking feelings start at some specific point in time?

Yeah, actually... it's been going on for about a year and two months now. That was right around the time my agency changed me to rotating overnight shifts. And they added a bunch of extra paperwork for me to do, too. So I guess that's when it all really started.
Have you been feeling sad or hopeless most of the time since your sleep problems started?

Yeah, I have. Most days, honestly, I just feel... heavy. And empty, right from the minute I open my eyes. It's like the person I used to be is just gone. The one who used to go to church, or do Zumba, or help the kids out at the center... I just don't feel like her anymore. She's just gone.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable, like Zumba?
No, I don't. I haven't been to Zumba in a long time. I just... I don't have the energy for it, and honestly, the thought of doing it doesn't even sound fun anymore. I just don't care about it.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?
No, not really. I can't think of anything. Everything just feels like a chore now, honestly. I just don't have interest in doing much of anything.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

Yeah, all the time. I just... I keep going over every little thing I ever did wrong. Like with the patients I take care of, or with my family. It just plays on a loop in my head. I feel like I'm a completely worthless aide, honestly. And... I just feel like God is mad at me because I didn't protect people better when I should have.
How long have you been feeling sad and empty, like the person you used to be is gone?
It's been going on for about a year and two months. It all started when my agency switched me to rotating overnight shifts and gave me a bunch of extra paperwork.
Are there any small things that still bring you a little bit of happiness or joy?
No, I... I really don't think so. I know you asked that already, but it's just the truth. There's nothing that brings me joy anymore. It's all just empty.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy over the past two weeks?

I don't know... I guess I just don't have the energy to care about much of anything anymore. I don't really do anything besides work and sleep. I don't even know what I used to enjoy doing, honestly. It's just all a blur.
How long have you been feeling this way, with no pleasure in activities and feeling heavy and empty, without any periods of improvement?

I don't really know... I guess just the whole time? Like I said, it's been about a year and two months since it all started. I haven't really noticed any times where it felt better or lighter. It's just been the same heavy feeling every day since then.
Have you had any periods of at least two months where you felt better and your symptoms improved significantly since this all started?
No... I haven't. Like I just said, it hasn't let up at all. There hasn't been any break where I felt better, definitely not for two whole months. It's just been constant.
